scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide-angle view of a city street with tall buildings lining both sides, featuring a mix of commercial and residential structures, including a large billboard on the left side of the street and a row of trees along the sidewalk on the right. The street is bustling with pedestrians and vehicles, including cars, trucks, and bicycles, creating a lively urban atmosphere. The clear blue sky adds to the vibrant ambiance of the scene.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings in the image feature a mix of modern and traditional architectural styles, with some having flat facades and others displaying ornate details such as balconies and decorative trim. Some buildings have large windows, while others have smaller ones, adding to the visual interest of the scene.

scene_analysis.vegetation: The trees lining the street are mostly deciduous, with some displaying autumnal colors. They add a touch of greenery to the otherwise urban landscape.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs visible, including street signs, directional indicators, and advertisements. Some signs are brightly colored and eye-catching, while others are more subdued.
